verdict.rationale: Region or residency selection is a fair question for an AI inference cloud, but nothing in the evidence documents choosing where data is stored or processed. The zero-retention policy, SOC 2/ISO 27001 certification and dedicated instances for data isolation are related privacy controls, not region or residency choice, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
